name: music_library_e2e_acceptance_v1
_comment: ADR-0022 GATE-1 acceptance contract for PR #1398 (MiniMax music) + feature #1358.
Top-level 'expected_tool_calls' + 'must_not_call' are the GATE-1 schema fields;
agent-flow-e2e-process.sh validates them via jq and refuses to set e2e-done
without them. Per-step 'acceptance' blocks give the validator fine-grained checks
(tool was called for THIS specific user prompt; not just somewhere in the run).
Coverage rationale: one acceptance.json covers ALL 7 new gen_* tools so a single
PASS truly proves the full feature (ADR-0022 §5.3). ml02_sing_song_about_cat is
the EXACT failure phrase from run #32158261168 (issue #1403) — before the fix
LLM called execute_music_code and replied «у меня нет такой функции». With
the fix LLM routes через MusicSkill → generate_music (40-160с MiniMax gen).
ml07_renardo_path is the NEGATIVE control — must still call execute_music_code
(Renardo live-engine); if LLM wrongly routes «сыграй renardo бит» к gen_*, the
renardo path breaks. Pattern: 'must_not_call' on per-step basis (Renardo steps).
gen_play_from_library is NOT covered by a per-step block because e2e needs a
pre-existing track in /data/music_library (post-condition of generate_music).
GATE-1 top-level expected_tool_calls INCLUDES it; per-step coverage is partial
by design. After ml02_sing_song_about_cat PASSES the robot owns a track, so
a follow-up voice command «сыграй последний трек» exercises gen_play_from_library
Voice file format: 48kHz opus OGG, ≤4s, VAD max=12s, volume≥150 (per
VOICE_COMMANDS_RESEARCH.md). Pre-recorded with edge-tts ru-RU-DmitryNeural

steps.label: ml01_generate_romantic
steps.text: Робот, сгенерируй бычок на лугу грустную композицию в стиле эмбиент

acceptance._comment_issue: #1403 — exact failure phrase from e2e run #32158261168. Before the fix the LLM called execute_music_code and told the user «у меня нет такой функции». With the fix the LLM calls generate_music, the song is generated via MiniMax Music API in 40-160s, and the user hears the actual song (not «бит на 110 bpm»).
